/.title: Lunacy Media | Mythology & Worldbuilding Studio
/.description: Lunacy Media is a Toronto-based mythology and worldbuilding studio creating original IP, cultural narratives, music, and immersive digital experiences.
/.ogDescription: Original IP, mythology-driven branding, and worldbuilding across music, graphic novels, interactive experience, and cultural strategy.
/.intro: Lunacy Media builds worlds, identities, and cultural narratives for artists, founders, and organizations who were never meant to be ordinary.

sections.heading: Worlds with a point of view
sections.body: We connect music, original IP, visual systems, and immersive experiences into coherent mythologies that people can enter and remember.

/studio.title: Studio Services | Lunacy Media
/studio.description: Explore Lunacy Media’s Toronto-based creative studio services, from narrative identity and worldbuilding to digital experiences, music, and creative direction.
/studio.ogDescription: Narrative identity, worldbuilding, digital experiences, music, and creative direction for culturally resonant brands and artists.
/studio.intro: Lunacy develops foundational identities, narrative systems, and full creative ecosystems for work that needs to hold attention and meaning.

sections.heading: Nebula — Foundational Identity
sections.body: Strategic positioning, visual identity systems, brand guidelines, and logos for ideas in their first visible form.

sections.heading: Neutron — Narrative Brand System
sections.body: Web design, interactive experiences, user experience design, and technical implementation that give a story a durable structure.

sections.heading: Nova — Full Creative Ecosystem
sections.body: An integrated world of identity, mythology, characters, cultural strategy, and multi-disciplinary production.

/work.title: The Trisomy | Lunacy Media Work
/work.description: Discover The Trisomy, Lunacy Media’s three-part music world exploring identity, memory, grief, inheritance, and becoming.
/work.ogDescription: Mulligan, Between the Last Letters, and Kalu Ram: three records forming one mythic autobiography.
/work.intro: A life story split across identity, memory, grief, inheritance, and becoming. The albums are phases of one mythic autobiography rather than separate releases.

sections.heading: A narrative architecture
sections.body: Mulligan, Between the Last Letters, and Kalu Ram create a release language, symbolic vocabulary, and audience entry points built to hold evolution rather than only promotion.

/worlds.title: Original Worlds | Lunacy Media
/worlds.description: Explore Lunacy Media original worlds across music, graphic novels, and immersive experiences, including The Trisomy, Obeah, and Tammy.
/worlds.ogDescription: Original intellectual property across music, graphic novels, and immersive experiences that continues to evolve across mediums.
/worlds.intro: Lunacy develops original intellectual property as complete universes that exist across multiple mediums and keep evolving.

sections.heading: The Trisomy
sections.body: A three-part musical odyssey exploring identity, memory, and legacy through hip-hop, poetry, and worldbuilding.

sections.heading: Obeah
sections.body: A contemporary spiritual mythology reclaiming Caribbean and African tradition through graphic novel form.

sections.heading: Tammy
sections.body: An immersive psychological experience about misinformation, identity, and the systems that shape what people believe.

/mythology.title: Lunacy Mythology | Lunacy Media
/mythology.description: Learn the story and core beliefs behind Lunacy Media: emotional truth, functional mythology, evolving identity, and creativity as an evolutionary force.
/mythology.ogDescription: The story of Lunacy Media, its core beliefs, and the mythology behind its creative practice.
/mythology.intro: Lunacy Media began as a long-term archive of evolution: a practice of building worlds that hold emotional truth, strategy, and collective possibility together.

sections.heading: Emotional truth has structural power
sections.body: The deepest truths about human experience can be encoded into systems, brands, and worlds.

sections.heading: Mythology is functional, not fiction
sections.body: Every identity and world operates through myths. Lunacy makes those frameworks visible and useful.

sections.heading: Identity is continuously constructed
sections.body: Creation is a way to reflect, revise, and intentionally reshape what comes next.

/contact.title: Initiate a Project | Lunacy Media
/contact.description: Contact Lunacy Media in Toronto to discuss mythology-led creative direction, original IP, identity systems, music, and immersive digital experiences.
/contact.ogDescription: Tell Lunacy Media what you are building, what feels unresolved, and what you want people to believe when they encounter your world.
/contact.eyebrow: THE FIRST PAGE OF THE MYTHOS BRIEF
/contact.intro: Tell us what you are building, what feels unresolved, and what you want people to believe when they encounter the world around your work.

sections.heading: The Signal
sections.body: Lunacy Media is based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Email: info@lunacymedia.ca.

sections.heading: Response
sections.body: Every signal is read with care. If the fit is there, you will hear back within 24 business hours.
